text: Implementing CHR numeric boundaries under #5611/#6776 on fix/chr-boundaries-5611. Fresh VFP9 evidence at /home/rich/temp/vfp9-probes/chr-5611/ shows its asymmetric legacy conversion: positive values above 255 are error 11, while negative values first wrap through signed 32-bit conversion (negative multiples of 2^32 and negative integer-indefinite values become NUL; -4294967295 becomes byte 1). COPPERFIN keeps strict checked [0,255] behavior; VFP9 mode reproduces the quirk. Normal and ASan+UBSan+float-cast-overflow numeric/string tests pass.
